title: Oxford University Is Older Than the Aztec Empire
description: Teaching at Oxford began long before the Aztecs founded their great capital city.

scenes.text: Oxford University is older than the Aztec Empire.
scenes.subject: oxford
scenes.say: [excited] Oxford University is OLDER than the Aztec Empire.

scenes.text: There is evidence of teaching at Oxford as early as ten ninety six, more than nine hundred years ago.
scenes.subject: oxford
scenes.say: There is evidence of teaching at Oxford as early as ten ninety six, more than nine hundred years ago.

scenes.text: The Aztecs founded their capital city, Tenochtitlan, in thirteen twenty five. That is over two hundred years later.
scenes.subject: aztec
scenes.say: The Aztecs founded their capital city, Tenochtitlan, in thirteen twenty five. [gasps] That is over two hundred years later.

scenes.text: So students were already studying in Oxford long before one of the most famous empires in the Americas even began.
